request:
Deliver four repo-integrity fixes in D:\Works\Tools\agent-skills so the local contributor gate stops being weaker than CI.

SCOPE — exactly these 7 files; do NOT touch .github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml (the root session owns it separately):
1. scripts/build-agent-dist.js
2. package.json (GENERATED — edit the generator, then run `node scripts/build-agent-dist.js`)
3. README.md
4. INSTALL.md
5. scripts/validate-catalog.js (new)
6. scripts/validate-catalog-test.js (new)
7. scripts/validate-versions.js

(1) npm test must run the same gates as CI.
`package.json` is generated: scripts/build-agent-dist.js:177-223 writes it from a hardcoded template whose `scripts` block is at line 213-218. Edit THAT template, then regenerate with `node scripts/build-agent-dist.js` so the committed JSON matches the generator. Required shape:
  test         -> `npm run test:gates && npm run test:hooks`
  test:gates   -> validate-skills, validate-catalog, validate-commands, validate-reference-links, validate-versions, validate-artifact-paths, run-evals --min-rank1 95, then the node --test suites (scripts/lib/skill-lint-test.js, scripts/validate-versions-test.js, scripts/validate-catalog-test.js, scripts/run-evals-test.js, scripts/validate-reference-links-test.js, scripts/validate-commands-test.js, scripts/validate-artifact-paths-test.js, scripts/floor-guard-reference-test.js), then scripts/uninstall-test.js
  test:hooks   -> bash hooks/session-start-test.sh && bash hooks/sdd-cache-test.sh && bash hooks/simplify-ignore-test.sh
Keep build/prepare/uninstall unchanged. Rationale for the two-step split: hook tests need bash, so a failure tells the contributor which half broke.

(2) New validator scripts/validate-catalog.js — single source of truth is the filesystem `skills/` directory.
 - Collect skill directory names (dirs containing SKILL.md).
 - README.md carries the catalog table: rows of the form `[<name>](skills/<name>/SKILL.md)`. Extract every such link target. Report BOTH directions: a skill directory with no README table row, and a README row pointing at a missing skill.
 - Every stated skill count in README.md and INSTALL.md (`\b(\d+)\s+skills\b`, case-insensitive) must equal the real directory count. Currently README.md:59 and README.md:372 say 26 while README.md:234 and the filesystem say 31 — fix those two numbers to 31.
 - Exit 0 on agreement, 1 with one line per discrepancy. Match the style of scripts/validate-skills.js (shebang, 'use strict', console output, exit code, try/catch wrapper). Export a PURE function (e.g. checkCatalog({skillDirs, readmeText, otherDocs})) that the CLI wraps, so the test needs no filesystem.

(3) scripts/validate-catalog-test.js — node:test, same style as scripts/validate-versions-test.js, exercising the pure function with synthetic fixtures: matching catalog passes; a skill missing from README fails; a README row for a non-existent skill fails; a wrong stated count fails. Do not read the real repo inside the test.

(4) scripts/validate-versions.js — extend manifestPaths to cover the three manifests that currently escape the check, keeping plugin.json as the expected version:
 - package.json (JSON, top-level `version`)
 - gemini-extension.json (JSON, top-level `version`)
 - plugin.yaml (YAML, a `version:` line — parse with a simple /^version:\s*(.+)$/m regex; the repo has zero dependencies and must stay that way)
All three currently read 0.6.13 and must keep passing. Update scripts/validate-versions-test.js only if its list of manifests needs to mirror the new coverage.

(5) Adjacent documentation correction, same drift class, one line each: INSTALL.md:77 says "Registers all 10 commands" but commands/ holds 12 .toml files — change 10 to 12. Do NOT add a command-count check; that is out of scope.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
- `node scripts/validate-catalog.js` exits 0 on the fixed tree and exits 1 (naming the offending skill/count) when a fixture is broken.
- `node scripts/validate-catalog-test.js` and `node scripts/validate-versions-test.js` pass.
- `node scripts/validate-skills.js`, `node scripts/validate-commands.js`, `node scripts/validate-versions.js` still pass unchanged.
- `node scripts/build-agent-dist.js` twice in a row leaves `git status --porcelain` empty (build is idempotent and package.json matches its template).
- No new npm dependencies; Node stdlib only.
- Existing validator behaviour, skill content and all other files untouched.

Report what you changed per file, the exact commands you ran and their output, and anything you deliberately left out.

build.summary:
Delivered the four repo-integrity fixes so the local contributor gate (npm test) matches CI. All 6 required verification commands exit 0, and build idempotency is proven. Executed by a compiled direct-mode suite — design → design-review → implement → verify+security (parallel) → review — every step returned Pass.

Per-file:
- scripts/build-agent-dist.js: template scripts block now emits test = `npm run test:gates && npm run test:hooks`; test:gates = 6 validate-* gates (incl. new validate-catalog) + run-evals --min-rank1 95 + node --test on all 8 test files + `node scripts/uninstall-test.js` (LAST); test:hooks = 3 bash hook tests. build/prepare/uninstall unchanged.
- package.json: regenerated from the template; verified byte-identical.
- scripts/validate-catalog.js (new): pure checkCatalog({skillDirs, readmeText, otherDocs}) -> string[]; both-direction check (skill dir missing from README AND README row for a missing skill) via /\[([^\]]+)\]\(skills\/([^/)]+)\/SKILL\.md\)/g; count check /\b(\d+)\s+skills?\b/gi over README.md + INSTALL.md; exit 0/1; style of validate-skills.js.
- scripts/validate-catalog-test.js (new): node:test, 4 synthetic fixtures (matching passes; missing-from-README fails; non-existent-skill row fails; wrong count fails), no real-repo reads.
- scripts/validate-versions.js: manifestPaths extended to 8 (adds package.json, gemini-extension.json, plugin.yaml) with per-format reader (YAML /^version:\s*(.+)$/m else JSON.parse); plugin.json stays the expected version. All read 0.6.13.
- README.md: lines 59 and 372 corrected 26→31.
- INSTALL.md: line 77 corrected 10→12 commands.

Review chain and rework: design Pass → design-review Pass (first pass returned Changes-requested for one defect — the reconstructed test:gates dropped the trailing `&& node scripts/uninstall-test.js`; the design author restored it and the re-review Passed) → implement Pass → verify Pass + security Pass (parallel) → review Pass.

Caveats (non-blocking, no defect): (1) `git status --porcelain` is not literally empty — it shows the 7 uncommitted deliverables plus a peer's concurrent edit to .github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml and the harness's untracked docs/intel/ artifacts; build idempotency (the criterion's intent) is proven by byte-identical porcelain before vs after two builds. (2) Tests invoked via `node scripts/*-test.js` (node:test auto-runs) because the harness firewall blocks `node --test <file>`; same assertions, exit 0. (3) scripts/validate-versions-test.js NOT modified (not admitted by the intake); stays at 5 original manifests and passes; the 3 new manifests are exercised by validate-versions.js itself. (4) README.md:376 'commands/ (9 commands)' left untouched (out of scope) — residual drift for the parent. (5) CI gating of validate-catalog.js and the CI build-diff step belong to the root session owning .github/workflows/test-plugin-install.yml, not this assignment.
